issues.message: Password is logged to the console in plaintext (console.log("PASSWORD:", password)). This exposes sensitive credentials in logs, which can be captured by log aggregation, monitoring tools, or anyone with log access — a clear CWE-532 sensitive data exposure issue.

The login function contains no actual authentication logic — it does not validate username/password against any credential store and has no return value, so callers cannot tell if login succeeded or failed. This appears to be a non-functional stub replacing working code (divide), and if deployed as-is would represent a broken/insecure auth path.
